body.x: P&I System(www.vrsim.co.kr) introduced its cutting-edge VR simulator at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

P&I System is a contents and simulator production company and in this show, it displayed Korea's first walking motion simulator "M10 Walking", racing, automobile, parachuting, and aviation simulators.

Its simulator has been made with real-time data transmission and reception calculated by reverse engineering technology, so there is no sickness by using the VR device. A staff of P&I System said it will expand to B2C market as well.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
